materialChanges: Changed the clinical synthesis scene to claims-mapped, mapped seven existing methodological and privacy claims to it, and added a same-scene source note containing their complete existing source set.
Returned all ten candidate claim records from reviewed to pending-review so the maintainer, not the candidate, performs the authorized publication-state transition.
Added a self-explanation prompt to the end of the seedling worked example without changing its fictional values, calculations, or conclusion.
Wrapped the opening bias retrieval, delayed four-question retrieval, and faded practice prompt in semantic check directives while leaving their feedback after the attempted response.
Corrected the attribution's candidate-version label and disclosed this version 0.2.0 finalizer run, material-instructions digest, and actual revision scope.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The clinical recap is now claims-mapped. The complementarity, terminology, preregistration, open-methods, privacy-boundary, replication, and sensitivity claims all include scene-clinical-wrap-up, and the scene names every supporting existing source in a learner-visible source note while retaining the fictional, non-advisory boundary.
Every claim reviewStatus is pending-review in the final draft pack. Promotion is reserved to the maintainer's authorized post-finalization publication transition.

The assessment arithmetic remains correct: 3 lies within 2 to 13 and the replication interval upper endpoint 5 is below the prespecified threshold 8. The answer already keeps computational reproducibility, sensitivity analysis, and replication distinct and does not infer an unsupported combined estimate.

The seedling calculation remains correct: +0.4 cm lies within +0.2 to +1.8 cm and the replication interval upper endpoint +0.7 cm is below the prespecified +1.0 cm threshold. The conclusion is already bounded to the fictional tested conditions and preserves uncertainty.

A self-explanation prompt now closes the worked example by asking which preregistered or prespecified decision most strongly controls the calibrated conclusion and what would change if that decision changed.
The bias-activation prompt is now a uniquely identified retrieval check, with the explanatory feedback still positioned after the prompt.

The delayed four-question recall and the faded three-case practice are now uniquely identified retrieval and practice check directives, with each answer guide remaining after the learner commits a response.

The clinical crossover example remains explicitly fictional teaching material, states that it is not medical advice, makes no real treatment or effect claim, and ends with a bounded methodological conclusion.

evidenceChecked: All six ordered scene files retain one level-one heading, semantic source order, balanced declarative directives, and prompts before feedback; no raw HTML, HTML entity, script, remote embed, Markdown image, or executable content was introduced.

The concept-map diagram has concise alt text and a relationship-complete long description; the same four safeguards are also available as a Markdown table and a before-inspect-new data-alternatives text map without color or position dependence.

Numeric worked-example information appears in a Markdown table and is interpreted in prose. Assessment responses may be given in prose, bullets, or a table; attempts are untimed and retakeable, and no task requires dragging, hovering, sound, image recognition, speed, laboratory access, or disclosure of personal information.

The clinical and plant examples are explicitly fictional and non-advisory. Participant privacy is taught through consent, de-identification, controlled-access, and data-use-agreement boundaries without including identifiable participant or patient data.

All ten claims resolve to declared scenes and existing sources, every claims-mapped scene has a learner-visible source note with the complete source set for its mapped claims, and all four assessment items retain string-valued acceptableResponses.

All seven source records use permitted source types and record factual-reference use, facts-only original expression, concrete rights-basis evidence, dated agent-access status, and terms locations; none is marked human-only.

The pack declares CC BY 4.0 course content, identifies the accountable principal and material agent runs, records this finalizer's run ID and instruction digest, and includes no third-party asset. The declarative diagram and all fictional data, cases, prompts, and tables are attributed as original.
limitations: This file-scoped audit did not exercise a browser, screen reader, 200% zoom, narrow-view reflow, print output, reduced-motion mode, or unavailable non-web export adapters.
The finalizer audited the recorded source-use, rights, license, and agent-access evidence but did not revisit live source pages or independently re-check current website terms.
No real learner-performance evidence is available; first-read clarity and mastery design were judged from the static lesson and the preserved learning-design review.
The imposed scope excluded site data, schemas, the graph record, and the cross-lesson terminology registry, so those external mappings were not independently inspected in this run.

Repository npm validation and strict source preflight were not run because the operator explicitly prohibited npm; pack-local JSON, evidence-link, directive, answer-type, reference-field, raw-markup, and diff checks passed.

rationale: The original candidate and exactly two eligible advisory artifacts were considered: one academic and one learning-design review against the same candidate, with distinct disclosed run IDs and providers and no declared conflicts. Both reviews requested changes; all eight indexed findings are disposed, all five requested changes are incorporated, and the three affirmative accuracy or clinical-framing notes require no content change. The revised pack preserves the original scientific calculations and conclusions, repairs the clinical evidence trail and candidate review states, improves retrieval semantics and worked-example reflection, and passes the finalizer's pack-local academic, assessment, accessibility, security, and rights checks. The committed artifacts and the operator-supplied non-dismissed COMMENTED transport state support the standard advisory-input gate, but provenance diversity is disclosed and attested rather than independently verified, and this run did not query GitHub. Subject to the recorded operator substitutions and repository checks, no credible unresolved blocker remains.
dissent: Both eligible advisory reviews returned request-changes against the original candidate. Their requested material changes are incorporated here, but neither reviewer is represented as having reviewed or approved the final edit.
conditions: The operator must commit the final content, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character commit SHA, and stamp the four RUNTIME-STAMPED agent-identity fields from the runtime banner without changing teaching content.
The operator must run the required strict source preflight and repository validation and confirm the equivalent non-dismissed GitHub COMMENTED review transports before merge.
The maintainer must perform only the permitted post-finalization publication transition for lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim reviewStatus fields.
